title: The Melody of Light
template:
Deep within the ancient hall sat a harp made of pure light. Its strings were crafted from [material] and sparkled under the moon. Everyone who saw it felt a sense of [emotion] washing over them.

A brave musician reached out to play a single, soft note. As their fingers touched the strings, the harp began to [vibration_verb] softly. The sound resonated through the hollow pillars of the temple.

Suddenly, the room filled with a [glow_color] light that danced on the walls. The melody made the nearby flowers [flower_action] in perfect rhythm. It was the most beautiful music the world had ever heard.

blanks.hint: a verb describing a sound or movement
